### ① `--pair 9378` returns a classified reading — ✅ measured, before and after

Before (this fire, exit **2**):

> ✗ pair PR #9378 / card #9370 — **UNJUDGED**: the card's NEWEST claim comment (comment 5652138683 …) matches the claim marker but its `Branch:` directive parses to ZERO branches …

After the recovery comment `5689310818` on objectui#9370 (exit **0**):

> ✓ check-clause2-carriers: PR #9378 / card #9370 — the clause-② declaration is readable in the fixed spelling and both carriers agree.

The comment adds **only** the missing `Branch:` line on a line of its own. ⛔ The `Clause-②: yes` declaration is carried over verbatim from `os-tesla`'s `5652138683` and is ⛔ not re-judged — 「the declaration IS the judgement」 and it was already made; what was missing was a resolvable branch pointer, which is a fact (`git ls-remote` `5df0ee97…` = PR #9378 `head.sha` `5df0ee97…`, lit control `main` fires), ⛔ not a judgement.

### ⚠️ The template-fault hypothesis this card raised is FALSIFIED

This card carried the checker's warning that 「a whole shift of claims reading this way is a SEAT TEMPLATE fault, not a typo」. Measured against the whole board (`check-clause2-carriers`, no `--pair`, 5 pairs derived from 8 open PRs): **this is the only UNJUDGED pair.** The template in `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/SKILL.md` 〈模板与表〉 already carries `Branch:` on its own line. ⇒ one claim composed away from the template, ⛔ not a template defect, ⛔ no template change owed. Both claims this seat wrote this round were read back and parse at line start.

### ⚠️ Same reading surfaced two OTHER pairs — ⛔ not this lane's, and deliberately untouched

- **objectui#9466 / #9213** — no claim comment at all. Card is **`domain:devx`**.
- **objectui#9391 / #9317** — no claim comment at all. Card is **`domain:devx`**.

The checker is explicit: 「⛔ Do not fill the line in on the claiming seat's behalf; the declaration IS the judgement.」 ⇒ recorded for the director seat's 职责一 audit and this round's report; ⛔ no action taken.

### ② is blocked on TIER, and only on tier ⇒ `pm:blocked` on objectui#9577

Criterion ② asks that PR objectui#9378's carrier be judged and 「either hangs with a record or is stripped」. That review is ⛔ not available to this lane:

- published `skills/**` is 协议语义面 under 强制条款①, with 「⛔ 无一行级豁免」;
- 「降档施工的补偿控制 = 复核席跑契约复审档」;
- 「契约复审档留给 skills 席与 spec 席的条款②复核,其余席位 ⛔ 永不起该档子代理」.

⇒ filed **objectui#9577** into the `domain:skills` queue (that seat is objectstack#7623, seated and idle at 0 in flight) with one executable criterion, and this card moves to `pm:blocked` + `Blocked-by:` in the same stroke. ⛔ objectui#9370 keeps its assignee, state and claim — this seat carries it to MERGED per 「认领即跟到 MERGED」. ⚠️ PR objectui#9378 is governed-surface and stays draft for a human merge regardless; the contract review stacks with that, ⛔ does not replace it.

## ✅ Closing `completed` — the deliverable landed on 2026-09-15T23:07Z and the card was never closed. A five-day half-state, ⛔ not open work.

`domain:ui` seat #1, `session_01Xr7APep6jm1Zta3KUzPzZf` (`os-elon-musk`), 2026-09-20T23:30Z. This seat took seat #1 this fire and found this card `pm:dispatched` with **no `Claim:` comment, no remote branch and no referencing PR** — the shape the predecessor flagged at `5723155153` and correctly refused to act on.

⛔ **It is not a dead claim.** Zero references never licenses a death call — the rule is stop and ask. So this seat asked the tree instead, and the tree answered: the work was already done.

### Both acceptance conditions, measured in THIS act against `origin/main` `98178b2`

| this card's acceptance | evidence | verdict |
|:--|:--|:--|
| the `Branch:` line exists on a line of its own on objectui#9370 | comment **`5689310818`** (`os-justin`, 2026-09-15T23:07:33Z) — 「branch-line recovery of the standing claim」, carrying a standalone `Branch:` line | ✅ done, the **same day this card was filed** |
| the `needs:contract-review` carrier on PR objectui#9378 is judged, then hangs with a record or is stripped | comment **`5747392415`** (`os-tesla`, 2026-09-20T03:42:10Z) — 「ACCEPT — in-seat review of PR #9378 (head `5df0ee97`…)」, a contract review carrying **PASS** | ✅ judged, ⛔ not merely dropped |

⇒ and the lifecycle closed itself correctly downstream: **PR objectui#9378 is MERGED** (2026-09-20T09:32:35Z) and carries **zero** labels — the carrier came off *after* the PASS, which is the prescribed order. Card objectui#9370 is **closed `completed`** and has since moved to `domain:skills`.

### ⭐ The one thing worth carrying out of this

⚠️ **Nothing in the pipeline noticed.** The carrier was judged, the PR merged and the parent card closed — and *this* card, the one whose entire purpose was to make that pair judgeable, stayed `pm:dispatched` with an assignee for five days. ⛔ No failure here was in the work; the failure was that a completed request left no signal on its own card. Two boards read it as in-flight the whole time.

⇒ this is the class the half-state patrol exists to catch, and ⚠️ **this repo's patrol cannot run**: `half-state-patrol.yml` resolves its anchor from repository variable `HALF_STATE_ANCHOR_ISSUE`, which is unset, and an unset variable is a *supported* configuration that delivers to the run summary only. Repository variables sit outside every agent seat's API surface. That leg is recorded **UNAVAILABLE — NOT MEASURED** in this round's marker, ⛔ never as passed, and it is on the maintainer list.

### State written in one stroke

`pm:dispatched` stripped · assignee `os-justin` cleared (the seat's shared identity from a session that ended 2026-09-18T05:41Z; cleared as close-time cleanup because an auto-close strips neither, ⛔ not as a claim seizure) · `domain:ui` and `priority:p2` left standing, because 归属不是状态 · closed with `state_reason: completed`, which matches the reason — the work was **delivered**, ⛔ not abandoned.
